```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)
library(here)
library(flextable)
```

```{r}
credit <- read_csv(here("data", "Credit_Update.csv")) |> 
  clean_names()
```

## Introduction

```{r}
n <- nrow(credit)
```

The credit data is collected in August, 2026. The dataset contains information of credit card holders of the bank. Total number of people in the dataset is `r n`.

## Demography

```{r}
n_male <- credit |> filter(gender == "Male") |> nrow()
n_female <- credit |> filter(gender == "Female") |> nrow()
```

The data covers `r n_male` males and `r n_female` females. The following table shows the ethnicity breakdowns.

```{r}
tbl_ethnicity <- credit |> 
  count(ethnicity) |> 
  flextable() |> 
  autofit()

tbl_ethnicity
```

## Income distribution

```{r}
med_inc <- round_half_up(median(credit$income, na.rm = TRUE), 2)
min_inc <- round_half_up(min(credit$income, na.rm = TRUE), 2)
max_inc <- round_half_up(max(credit$income, na.rm = TRUE), 2)
```

Median income of the participant is `r med_inc` USD, ranging from `r min_inc` to `r max_inc` . Figure below show the income distribution.

```{r}
credit |> 
  ggplot(aes(income)) + 
  geom_density(fill = "lightblue") +
  labs(
    x = "Income (in thousand)",
    y = "Number of participants"
  )
```

```{r}
avg_bal <- round_half_up(mean(credit$balance, na.rm = TRUE), 2)
```

Average credit balance is `r avg_bal` USD. As shown in the following figure, African American people recorded highest credit balance on average, followed by Caucasian.

```{r}
credit |> 
  summarize(
    .by = ethnicity,
    avg_balance = round_half_up(mean(balance, na.rm = TRUE), 2)
  ) |> 
  ggplot(aes(ethnicity, avg_balance, fill = ethnicity)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  labs(
    x = "Ethnicity group",
    y = "Average credit balance"
  )
```

## Variable associated with balance

There is a possible positive relationship between the credit card balance and annual income of card holders. The person who earns more is likely to have better credit balance.

```{r}
credit |> 
  ggplot(aes(income, balance)) +
  geom_point(color = "darkblue", alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
  labs(
    x = "Income (in thousand)",
    y = "Credit balance"
  )
```
